text.en: Diksha visited the India Gate, Qutub Minar, Akshardham and other monuments in Delhi. Now she wants to make a model of India Gate with wooden blocks.

Diksha went to Delhi in the summer holidays and saw old and new monuments like India Gate, Qutub Minar, Safdarjung Tomb, Akshardham, the National Museum, Jantar Mantar and Sansad Bhawan.
She tries to make a model of India Gate using her wooden blocks. Which parts will you show: the roof, pillars, base?
Choose block shapes that look like each part. Pillars may be cuboids or cylinders, a dome may be half a sphere, a tower like the Qutub Minar may be a tall cone-like shape.
Compare your model with the real building. Say how it is similar and how it is different.
What happens if you remove one piece? The model may not look like the original building.
Project idea: observe a street and make a model of its main buildings.
